name: Tenniscore
reacts_against: streetwear's logo-forward maximalism, favoring clean, sport-coded preppiness instead.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Tennis skirts, polo shirts, tennis dresses, visors, sweatbands, tennis bracelets
wiki_facts.key_values: Athleticism, classic style, preppiness, luxury, leisure

findings: mostly muted — about 61% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Aesthetics Wiki photos as photographed and displayed on screen; actual garments and materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
